name: Match Legends
summary:
We're transitioning to free-to-play to reach more players! For our early supporters who purchased - thank you for believing in us. Your support helped us get here.

Match Legends is a vibrant VR memory-matching adventure for Meta Quest 2/3/Pro. Flip cards in a 4x4 grid, racing against a dynamic timer that tightens across 32 levels (60s → 30s).
